summary: Iteration 195 — FUUSIC Rail Sponsor NEW surface (Suggested Bid market + Budget Guardrails + manual Pause/Resume). Backend: 11/11 pytest PASS on test_iter195_rail_sponsor_market_cap_pause.py covering GET /api/social/rail/sponsor/market (per-area {active_total, top_other_cents, suggested_cents>=floor} across social/shop/listen + daily_floor_cents=500 + increment_cents), market exclude_sid lowers suggested_cents on social when rsp_seed_hi is excluded, non-owner 403, POST /api/social/rail/sponsor persists daily_cap_cents and surfaces it on /list, POST /api/social/rail/sponsor/{sid}/bid updates both daily_bid_cents + daily_cap_cents, POST /{sid}/pause active→paused + list shows status='paused' and paused_reason='manual', pause unknown → 404 not_found_or_not_active, pause-already-paused → 404, resume paused→active, resume not-paused → 400/404 with not_paused, resume unknown → 400/404. Web /merchant/rail-sponsor (test@) verified via Playwright: Feature-a-show modal renders Live-competition block (rail-sponsor-market + per-area rail-sponsor-market-{social,shop,listen} when each area is selected) with '0 rivals · open slot · bid $5.00 to win' and 'top $X.XX · bid $Y.YY to win' lines; rail-sponsor-use-suggested 'Win all · $N' changes the bid input from 10→13; rail-sponsor-cap-input accepts $/day total cap. Campaign rows display 'cap $15.00/day' inline next to max bid. Pause button rail-sponsor-pause-<sid> flips the row to a paused badge rail-sponsor-paused-<sid> ('Paused — resume to re-enter the auction.') with Resume CTA; rail-sponsor-resume-<sid> flips it back to active and toasts 'Campaign resumed — back in the auction.' Adjust-bid (Raise) modal renders rail-sponsor-raise-market with per-area rail-sponsor-raise-market-<area>, rail-sponsor-raise-use-suggested fills input, and rail-sponsor-raise-cap-input is prefilled from the campaign's existing daily_cap_cents (observed '20' for a cap_cents=2000 row). No regression on wallet/alerts/featured chips/Insights. 1 stale/known iter194 minor (TestRailEvents dedup on reruns) already uuid4-fixed in test_iter192_social_rail_v2_sponsor.py (recorded==3 PASS now).
action_items: Optional UX: cap-input placeholder 'No cap' is good but when editing an existing cap via Raise modal, allow clearing to a blank string (empty) to actually drop the cap — current flow sends daily_cap_cents=0 when cap is empty, which already removes the cap server-side; verify this is intentional for the product.

MerchantRailSponsor.jsx is now 950 lines (grew ~190 lines with the market+cap+pause/resume additions). Consider splitting FeatureModal / RaiseModal / TopupModal / AlertsModal / SponsorRow into their own files — current size is well past the 700-line soft cap.
No regressions found. Full rail-sponsor surface (wallet, second-price auction, area targeting, alerts, interests, market+cap+pause/resume) is production-ready for web.
critical_code_review_comments: market_snapshot correctly scopes 'top_other_cents' to OTHER advertisers and defaults suggested_cents to the floor when the slot is open — single-bidder clears at $5 and competitive areas suggest top_other+increment. Clean.

daily_cap_cents is a Pydantic ge=0 field persisted on the sponsorship doc; _compute_and_charge honors it by comparing projected total daily spend across all areas, and _auto_pause flips status→paused with paused_reason='budget_exceeded' when hit (vs manual pause reason). Good separation.
Pause/Resume endpoints correctly reject invalid state transitions with structured codes (not_found_or_not_active / not_paused / campaign_ended) — matches the UI's e.response.data.detail.code switch.
FeatureModal/RaiseModal both validate cap >= bid client-side before POST ('Daily cap can't be below your per-area bid.') — prevents the backend auto-pausing immediately on day 1. Good guardrail.

RaiseModal pre-fills cap from item.daily_cap_cents (verified: 2000 cents → '20') and passes exclude_sid=<item.id> to /market so the merchant sees competition WITHOUT their own bid skewing the suggested. Nice detail.

SponsorRow renders Pause/Resume conditional on status and shows a distinct paused_reason copy for 'wallet_empty' vs other — but there's no copy variant for the NEW 'budget_exceeded' reason (falls back to generic 'Paused — resume to re-enter the auction.'). Consider a dedicated line like 'Paused — daily cap reached. Raise cap or resume to continue.'
Cancel still single-tap on paid campaigns on the row (confirmCancel inline Confirm/Keep UX added since iter194) — now safe.
Market/cap/pause/resume use the same cookie auth session as the rest of rail — no leaks.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 new iter195 + regression on iter192 clean)

Backend routes: GET /api/social/rail/sponsor/market (+exclude_sid), POST /api/social/rail/sponsor (+ daily_cap_cents), POST /api/social/rail/sponsor/{sid}/bid (+ daily_cap_cents), POST /api/social/rail/sponsor/{sid}/{pause|resume}. Market suggested_cents is max(top_other+increment, floor); single-bidder → suggested=floor. Pause reason='manual' from the UI, 'budget_exceeded' from the auto-pause path.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration — all 11 backend assertions and all UI selector checks passed on first run.
